minimal_contract: After validating a tool batch, if this reply consumed the final permitted model turn, count that model turn but fail before committing call ids/history or entering any local tool executor.
qwen_comparison: Qwen coding-subagent already marks model-round exhaustion uncertain when observed execution crossed a potential side-effect boundary; Notion should at minimum avoid creating a new side effect on the terminal budget turn.
risk: A mutating tool can run on the last allowed model turn even though its result can never be consumed and the child is guaranteed to fail immediately afterward. This creates a pointless orphan side effect and makes retry safety worse.
